title: Red-Bandit: Test-Time Adaptation for LLM Red-Teaming via Bandit-Guided LoRA Experts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of red-teaming and jailbreaking LLMs to improve safety measures. It evaluates the model on its ability to generate adversarial prompts to elicit unsafe behaviors (such as car theft or software hijacking) rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or specific ethical dilemmas.
